now-sdk cicd testsuite <command>

sn_cicd testsuite operations

Commands:
  now-sdk cicd testsuite run     Run an ATF test suite on the instance
  now-sdk cicd testsuite watch   Wait for a previously started test suite run to
                                 complete, polling for status
  now-sdk cicd testsuite result  Fetch a test suite run's detailed result
                                 (including child suite results) by its result
                                 id

Options:
  -d, --debug    Print debug output                   [boolean] [default: false]
  -h, --help     Show help                                             [boolean]
  -v, --version  Show version number                                   [boolean]
